blocks.text: Burke Mountain homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Burke Mountain, September 2026. Detached houses: 65 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 5% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 77 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 55.8 listed, about 6.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 19 sold. Condos and townhomes: 74 sold over 4 months against an average of 68.8 listed, about 3.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 27 sold.

faq.q: Which school district and schools serve Burke Mountain?
faq.a: School District 43 (Coquitlam). SD43 names Smiling Creek Elementary and Coast Salish Elementary as Burke Mountain–area schools; catchments are address-based, so run the exact address in the SD43 School Locator — no Burke Mountain address-level result is verified in this file.

faq.q: What sold in Burke Mountain in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 3 solds from 65 listings (5% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 11 solds from 77 listings (14%). At the Coquitlam community level the detached median sale price was $1,455,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $625,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station on Burke Mountain?
faq.a: No. The nearest Evergreen Extension stations are Coquitlam Central, Lincoln and Lafarge Lake-Douglas, and Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.

faq.q: Are there creek setbacks to check before building?
faq.a: Yes — a Watercourse Protection Development Permit can be required within 50 metres of the top of bank of any watercourse in Northeast Coquitlam, and Zoning Bylaw s.519 / s.523 set flood and riparian setbacks.

faq.q: When were Coquitlam property taxes due in 2026?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on any unpaid balance after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% penalty after September 15, 2026, including unclaimed Home Owner Grants.
